title: Destruction and Restoration

questions.question: I saw the Lord standing beside the what?
questions.explanation: Amos 9:1 (ESV): "I saw the Lord standing beside the altar,"

questions.question: Though they dig into Sheol, from there shall my hand take them; though they climb up to heaven, from there I will bring them where?
questions.explanation: Amos 9:2 (ESV): "though they climb up to heaven, from there I will bring them down."

questions.question: All the sinners of my people shall die by the what?
questions.explanation: Amos 9:10 (ESV): "All the sinners of my people shall die by the sword,"

questions.question: In that day I will raise up the booth of whom that is fallen?
questions.explanation: Amos 9:11 (ESV): "In that day I will raise up the booth of David that is fallen"

questions.question: I will plant them on their land, and they shall never again be uprooted out of the land that I have given them," says whom?

Though they hide themselves on the top of Carmel, from there I will search them out and take them; and though they hide from my sight at the bottom of the sea, there I will command the what to bite them?
questions.explanation: Amos 9:3 (ESV): "there I will command the serpent, and it shall bite them."

questions.question: The Lord God of hosts, he who touches the earth and it melts, and all who dwell in it do what?
questions.explanation: Amos 9:5 (ESV): "he who touches the earth and it melts, and all who dwell in it mourn,"

questions.question: Are you not like the whom to me, O people of Israel?
questions.explanation: Amos 9:7 (ESV): "Are you not like the Cushites to me, O people of Israel?"

questions.question: Behold, the eyes of the Lord God are upon the sinful kingdom, and I will destroy it from the surface of the ground, except that I will not utterly destroy the house of whom?
questions.explanation: Amos 9:8 (ESV): "except that I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob,"

questions.question: I will shake the house of Israel among all the nations as one shakes with a what?
questions.explanation: Amos 9:9 (ESV): "as one shakes with a sieve,"

questions.question: Smite the capitals until the thresholds shake, and shatter them on the heads of all the people; and those who are left of them I will kill with the sword; not one of them shall flee away; not one of them shall escape.
questions.explanation: Amos 9:1 (ESV): "Smite the capitals until the thresholds shake, and shatter them on the heads of all the people..."

questions.question: Did I not bring up Israel from the land of Egypt, and the Philistines from Caphtor and the Syrians from where?
questions.explanation: Amos 9:7 (ESV): "and the Philistines from Caphtor and the Syrians from Kir?"

questions.question: Behold, the days are coming," declares the Lord, "when the plowman shall overtake the reaper and the treader of grapes him who sows what?
questions.explanation: Amos 9:13 (ESV): "when the plowman shall overtake the reaper and the treader of grapes him who sows seed;"

questions.question: The mountains shall drip sweet wine, and all the hills shall flow with what?
questions.explanation: Amos 9:13 (ESV): "the mountains shall drip sweet wine, and all the hills shall flow with it."

questions.question: I will restore the fortunes of my people Israel, and they shall rebuild the ruined cities and inhabit them; they shall plant vineyards and drink their what?
questions.explanation: Amos 9:14 (ESV): "they shall plant vineyards and drink their wine,"

key_verse_text: In that day I will raise up the booth of David that is fallen and repair its breaches, and raise up its ruins and rebuild it as in the days of old,
